Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The study was limited to U.S. English and selected prompt formats, and the authors warn that underrepresented cultural contexts and other downstream tasks may not generalize; broad training prompts/completions could not be shared under their data policy.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

PALMS specified desired behavior for eight topic categories, created 80 training question–answer pairs, fine-tuned a language model, evaluated it and iterated on weaknesses.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

A contracted professional writer created 40–340-word completions; author-written answer outlines guided targeted prompts, and authors checked and modified broad-topic answers. Three blinded evaluators rated generated answers from 1 to 5 against desired behavior.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

On weakness-targeting question–answer evaluations with three completions per prompt at temperature 0.7, the values-targeted models had lower mean toxicity and higher mean human intended-sentiment ratings than base models; the authors report stronger improvements for larger models.
